sourceDependency: DUB-17 Theorem 2.6 / DUB-18 Corollary 8.2 -> higher symmetric-power continuation -> residual modular Galois association -> nonzero original residual H1 eigensystem -> realization of the prescribed character on the actual coefficient reduction.
reuseSearch: Checked pinned Mathlib support, residue-field, Artinian-module and tensor APIs and the already proved actual H1 character and tensor injection before adapting the archived finite-module eigenvector proof.
routeAdjustment: Specialize the operator-algebra consumer to integer coefficients to match the actual integral H1 algebra and reconcile its canonical integer module structure. Use pinned Basis.baseChange and Fitting decomposition. Preserve Apache-2.0 attribution and the archived LICENSE/NOTICE.
discharged: A prescribed character of a finite commuting integral operator algebra acting faithfully on a finite integral module is realized by a nonzero common eigenvector after tensoring with its target field. The proof derives nontriviality of the character fiber from support and obtains a common eigenvector with the prescribed eigenvalues using Fitting decomposition. Applied to the actual native integral H1, the previously proved injective tensor coefficient map gives a nonzero residual H1 class with all original good-prime eigenvalues, including the original primitive form and prescribed-prime local reduction. Character realization, tensor nonvanishing and reduction injectivity are derived.
remaining: Pairwise commutativity of the full original integral H1 good-prime operators remains an explicit premise. The original residual eigensystem is therefore conditional on precisely that premise. Weight/level reduction, geometric Galois association, an all-weight adic system, purity, crystallinity, Sato-Tate and higher symmetric-power automorphy remain open. Acceptance remains 16/20; DUB-17--20 are open.
production: Scratch only; production promotion and verification pending.
